clue.text: Insect group: its summer habitat is Oval or similar

definitions.text: its summer habitat is Oval or similar

parts.note: a cricket is a chirping insect
a team is a group playing together

explanation.surface: A naturalist describes a colony of chirping insects and where they spend the warm months.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads like zoology, but THE OVAL is a London cricket ground where a side plays all summer; the insect and the group combine to name the side.
explanation.definitionFit: A side of eleven players spends the English summer playing at grounds such as the Oval.

clue.text: No charge for attention that's without worry or responsibility

parts.note: care is close attention
free means at no charge

explanation.surface: Getting attention at no cost leaves someone relaxed.
explanation.definitionFit: Being carefree means having no anxieties or duties.

clue.text: Sick, overweight newspaperman is unlucky

parts.note: ill means sick
fat means overweight
ED, editor, is a newspaperman

explanation.surface: A portly, ailing journalist seems dogged by misfortune.
explanation.definitionFit: Doomed to misfortune, destined for bad luck.

clue.text: Piece of turf this country turned over for prestige

indicators.note: the whole run of pieces is turned back to front, as turf is turned over

parts.note: a sod is a piece of turf
UK, the setter's country, the United Kingdom

explanation.surface: Someone flips a clod of national soil and wins acclaim.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned over' reverses SODUK as a whole to give the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Kudos is honour and glory, prestige earned by achievement.

clue.text: Two changed the way canal boat owners walk on it

definitions.text: canal boat owners walk on it

indicators.note: the letters of two are changed into another arrangement

parts.note: a path is a way

explanation.surface: The route along which boaters on a canal stroll.
explanation.definitionFit: A path beside a canal along which horses once hauled the barges.

clue.text: Relaxing inside when one can cease full-time employment

indicators.note: the letters lie inside the words cease full-time

explanation.surface: Retirement from a full-time job is pictured as a relaxing release.
explanation.definitionFit: Easeful means comfortable and soothing, giving rest.

clue.text: Collection of vegetables came cooked to eat with nothing inside

indicators.note: the letters of came are cooked into a new arrangement
O goes inside the word for eating

parts.note: to dine is to eat
O is zero, nothing

explanation.surface: Someone cooks vegetables and eats them with nothing else in the dish.
explanation.walkthrough: A macedoine is a French dish name; 'cooked' is the anagram signal on the first word, and 'inside' places the zero within the verb for eating.
explanation.definitionFit: A macedoine is a mixture of diced vegetables or fruit.

clue.text: So black one has to weep

parts.note: B is the standard abbreviation for black, as on pencils; that the clue's opening letters also spell the run is a coincidence, as the setter builds it from two pieces

explanation.surface: Someone left in darkness has every reason to cry.
explanation.definitionFit: To sob is to cry with convulsive gasps, a strong form of weeping.

clue.text: Leading man starts to vomit excessively and go without food

parts.note: the leading man of a film is its star

indicators.note: the first letters of the following two words are taken

explanation.surface: A film's lead begins to be sick and stops eating.
explanation.definitionFit: To starve is to suffer from lack of nourishment.

clue.text: Food factory in street where Holmes lived, number unknown

parts.note: Sherlock Holmes lived at 221B Baker Street in London
Y is an unknown quantity in algebra

explanation.surface: A bread works stands on the detective's street, its house number unknown.
explanation.definitionFit: A bakery is a place where bread and cakes are made.

clue.text: Controlled rugby came first

parts.note: RU is short for Rugby Union
someone who came first led the field

explanation.surface: A sports report says rugby, as the leading game, dominated.
explanation.definitionFit: Something controlled was governed or held in authority.

clue.text: Sensible to take cocaine? That's a joke!

parts.note: a sensible person is wise
crack is a smokable form of cocaine

explanation.surface: A mocking question: is taking cocaine really the sensible choice?
explanation.definitionFit: A wisecrack is a smart, quick quip, a kind of joke.

clue.text: Get tired workers to provide support for standards

parts.note: to flag is to tire or lose energy
staff are the workers of an organisation

explanation.surface: Exhausted employees are told they must keep up the company's standards.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Standards' looks like quality levels, but here they are flags, and the pole holds them up.
explanation.definitionFit: A pole on which flags, also called standards, are hoisted holds them aloft.

clue.text: I have a medical man outside — he works underwater

indicators.note: the doctor's letters go around the outside of the other piece

parts.note: DR is the abbreviation for doctor
I have contracts to I've

explanation.surface: Someone explains they have a doctor standing by while a man works beneath the waves.
explanation.walkthrough: 'outside' wraps the doctor around the contraction of 'I have'; 'he' in the definition is just the person doing the job.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who works below the surface of the sea, often in a suit with air supply.

clue.text: They say I was on heroin. Rubbish!

indicators.note: the phrase signals that the words are heard rather than spelt

parts.note: the words 'I was' are pronounced like the eye-sounding start
H is slang for heroin

explanation.surface: A gossip passes on the rumour that someone was a heroin user and dismisses it as nonsense.
explanation.walkthrough: 'They say' makes 'I was' sound like EYE WAS; H for heroin follows, 'on' just joining the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Eyewash is nonsense or humbug, talk meant to deceive.

clue.text: Didn't drink or vote-spotted by sailor

parts.note: AB, able seaman, is a sailor
stained means marked with spots

explanation.surface: A teetotal abstention, smudged by a sailor's involvement.
explanation.definitionFit: To abstain is to refrain, both from alcohol and from casting a ballot.

clue.text: Opening of louvres to ventilate animal quarters

indicators.note: the opening of a word is its first letter, here from louvres

parts.note: to air a room is to ventilate it

explanation.surface: Slatted louvres are opened to let fresh air into an animal's pen.
explanation.definitionFit: A den is where a wild beast lives and rests.

clue.text: Shell fragments shattered her plans

indicators.note: her plans are shattered and the letters fall into new order

explanation.surface: Her plans are blown apart by an explosion.
explanation.definitionFit: Shrapnel is metal fragments from an exploding bomb or shell.

clue.text: Bitter is on the house and the spirit

parts.note: something on the house is free
zing is spirit or liveliness

explanation.surface: A pub offers a pint of bitter and a spirit, both on the house.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bitter' looks like the beer, but it means bitterly cold.
explanation.definitionFit: Bitter weather is extremely cold.

clue.text: Hissing sound to attract attention from rider on the way

parts.note: a postscript, PS, is a rider added to a letter
ST, street, is a way

explanation.surface: Someone tries to catch the eye of a passing horseman with a whisper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rider' seems to be on horseback, but it is an addition to a letter: the postscript.
explanation.definitionFit: A whispered sibilant used to get someone's attention discreetly.

clue.text: An occasion when Earl Grey might get drunk?

definitions.text: An occasion when Earl Grey might get drunk?

parts.words: An occasion when Earl Grey might get drunk?
parts.note: Earl Grey sounds like a nobleman getting drunk, but it is a tea, drunk at a particular hour of the afternoon

explanation.surface: A peer of the realm is suspected of a drinking session.
explanation.walkthrough: Earl Grey looks like an aristocrat on a binge; it is a blend of tea, and it gets drunk in the afternoon.
explanation.definitionFit: The time of day set aside for an afternoon cup and snacks.

clue.text: Student starting course that's more original

definitions.meaning: a first-year university student is called this in Britain
the comparative of fresh, newer or more novel

explanation.surface: A newcomer to university brings more original ideas.
explanation.definitionFit: A first-year undergraduate is new to college; and fresh means new or novel, so this is its comparative.

clue.text: Small figure on page used as a cover-up

parts.note: fig is short for figure
a leaf is a page of a book

explanation.surface: An illustration on a page used to hide something.
explanation.definitionFit: Statues once had a leaf of the fig tree to conceal nudity, so the term means a concealment.

clue.text: Flashes the odds on Noah's ships

parts.note: SP, starting price, gives the odds in betting
Noah built an ark; arks are such vessels

explanation.surface: A bookmaker quotes odds on the vessels of the Flood.
explanation.definitionFit: Sparks are small fiery flashes of light.

clue.text: Spy muddled revolutionary's mind. She Cupid's girl

indicators.note: the letters of spy are muddled into a new order

parts.note: Che Guevara is the archetypal revolutionary

explanation.surface: A confused agent disturbs a rebel's thinking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'muddled' turns SPY into PSY. The last sentence is a second definition: Psyche was the mortal loved by Cupid in myth.
explanation.definitionFit: The psyche is the human soul or mental self.

clue.text: Basic food of Romans long-ago before beginning of agriculture

parts.note: the long-ago is the past

indicators.note: the first letter of agriculture is taken

explanation.surface: Historians trace Roman staples back to before farming began.
explanation.definitionFit: Noodles made of durum wheat are the staple of Italian cooking.

clue.text: Theatrical backer wants something baked -a light sponge

parts.note: an angel is a financial backer of a stage show
a cake is a baked item

explanation.surface: A stage show's financier asks for a sweet treat.
explanation.definitionFit: A pale, airy sponge made with egg whites and no yolks.

clue.text: Practise deception at home and stay in bed

parts.note: to lie is to practise deception
someone at home is in

explanation.surface: A dishonest stay-at-home claims to be ill and lies abed.
explanation.definitionFit: To linger in bed later than usual in the morning.

clue.text: Reckon Kelvin is missing Chile without Henry? Settle for this

indicators.note: the word reckon loses one letter, signalled by being missing

parts.note: K is the symbol for kelvin, the unit of temperature

indicators.note: the word Chile goes without one of its letters

parts.note: H is the symbol for henry, the unit of inductance

explanation.surface: A puzzling instruction about a temperature unit and a country, offered as a compromise.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is missing' takes K out of RECKON to give RECON; 'without' takes H from CHILE to give CILE.
explanation.definitionFit: To reconcile a dispute is to resolve it, bringing the parties to agreement.

clue.text: Listlessness in summer, when nuisance value is high

indicators.note: the letters run inside the words when nuisance

explanation.surface: Boredom sets in during summer, when irritation runs high.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' points to the letters lying inside 'when nuisance'; 'summer' and 'value is high' only dress the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Ennui is weariness and boredom, a lack of energy or interest.

clue.text: Society, male and female

parts.note: he is the male pronoun

explanation.surface: A simple listing of a club's members by sex.
explanation.definitionFit: The pronoun for a woman, also used as a noun for a female animal.

clue.text: Man on boundary absorbed by excellent cricket side

parts.note: someone absorbed in thought is deep in it
fine means of high quality
leg is the on side of a cricket field

explanation.surface: A fielder caught up in an outstanding team effort stands near the rope.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer is a cricket fielding position on the boundary behind the batter on the leg side; 'absorbed' gives DEEP as in deep in thought.
explanation.definitionFit: A fielding position near the edge of the cricket ground, behind square on the leg side.
